description:
Two men and women trapped in the past,
In deep love
The secret of that day is revealed


Bulls Group 3 ‘Ryu Ji-seung’, who was featured in the media for his assault case and was photographed as the group's troublemaker
He meets ‘Yeon Si-eun’, who looks exactly like the child who died a long time ago, on Jiri Mountain, where he left to gather his body and mind.

C Department Store is assigned, not knowing whether it is demotion or mission.
Ji-seung meets Si-eun again at the new employee training center and feels an inexplicable and intense attraction.

“The assistant manager seems like a person from a different world than me. I am.. It's nothing.”
Even though the favor given by the man who lives on the clouds is burdensome,
Si-eun is helplessly shaken by Ji-seung, who approaches her recklessly.

Ryu Ji-seung, a man with an unhealed past
Yeon Si-eun, a woman with a past she can't remember

As the love between the two deepens, the secret of a tragic incident that occurred in the C Group about 20 years ago is revealed...
